weaken Bunnelby, then catch it in the catch window

metadata.source: played step by step from a new game. Ends on the game's autosave: each catch saves by itself, so the latest save moves past 03.07's start, and the backup save (the title's Up + B + X) holds 03.06's save, not a spot inside the zone. Whether the last catch save reloads before or after Taunie's talk (after_catches) is not checked
